;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]:
**Mortar fire kills two people near the [[Damascus Opera House]]. [https://news.yahoo.com/mortar-fire-kills-2-near-opera-syrian-capital-080739969.html (AP via Yahoo! News)]
*[[2014 pro-Russian protests in Ukraine]]:
**Pro-Russian demonstrators seize an administrative headquarters in the eastern Ukrainian city of [[Donetsk]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-26910210 (BBC News)]
*[[2014 Aswan tribal clashes]]:
**Two more people are killed in [[Egypt]]'s [[Aswan]] in a third day of clashes. Death toll rises to 25. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/04/06/us-egypt-violence-idUSBREA350CC20140406 (Reuters)] [http://www.businessweek.com/news/2014-04-06/two-killed-in-egypt-tribal-clashes-as-death-toll-rises-to-25 (Bloomberg)]

;Business and economy
*The world's two largest [[cement]] manufacturers, [[Lafarge (company)|LaFarge]] of [[France]] and [[Holcim]] of [[Switzerland]], agree to a merger that would create a firm with a market value of $55 billion. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/04/06/lafarge-holcim-idUSL6N0MY0DS20140406 (Reuters)]
*[[Economy of Nigeria|Nigeria's economy]] passes [[economy of South Africa|South Africa]]'s to become the largest in Africa. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-26913497 (BBC News]

;Law and crime
*The Ambassador of Italy to [[Turkmenistan]] is charged for alleged child abuse while on holiday in the [[Philippines]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/04/06/us-italy-philippines-diplomacy-idUSBREA350FR20140406 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Costa Rican general election, 2014]]:
**Voters in Costa Rica go to the polls for a general election. [[Luis Guillermo Solís]] is the only presidential candidate left in the race following the withdrawal of [[Johnny Araya]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-26908625 (BBC News)]
*[[Hungarian parliamentary election, 2014]]:
**Voters in Hungary go to the polls, and [[Prime Minister of Hungary|Prime Minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]]'s [[Fidesz]] and their allies the [[Christian Democratic People's Party (Hungary)|Christian Democrats]] win re-election easily, with 45% of the vote. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-26908404 (BBC News)]
*Russian municipal elections
**[[Communist Party of the Russian Federation]] candidate [[Anatoly Lokot]] was elected mayor of the third-largest city of [[Novosibirsk]], defeating ruling [[United Russia]] party candidate. [http://www.themoscowtimes.com/news/article/communist-party-deputy-elected-mayor-of-novosibirsk/497616.html (''The Moscow Times'')]

;Sports
*In [[cricket]], [[Australia national cricket team|Australia]] win the [[2014 ICC Women's World Twenty20|women's ICC World Twenty20 tournament]] and Sri Lanka win the [[2014 ICC World Twenty20|men's tournament]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/cricket/26895578 (BBC Sport)]
*In athletics, [[Kenenisa Bekele]] of Ethiopia wins the [[Paris Marathon]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20150602101146/http://www.france24.com/en/breaking/20140406-ethiopian-runner-kenenisa-bekele-wins-paris-marathon/?ns_campaign=al_en&ns_mchannel=email_marketing&ns_source=AL_20140406_1127&ns_linkname=20140406_breaking_news&ns_fee=0&f24_member_id=1080960490882 (France 24)]
*In [[Rowing (sport)|rowing]], [[Oxford University Boat Club|Oxford]] beats [[Cambridge University Boat Club|Cambridge]] in [[The Boat Race 2014|the 160th edition]] of [[The Boat Race]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/rowing/26869789 (BBC Sport)]
*In [[2014 in women's road cycling|women's road cycling]], [[Ellen van Dijk]] wins the [[2014 Tour of Flanders for Women|Tour of Flanders]] World Cup race. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/wales/26910453 (BBC Sport)]
